description: This Swift source file defines the `GeneralSettings` SwiftUI View for a macOS application related to OpenClaw. It manages various user-configurable settings such as connection modes, remote gateway configurations, health status, and gateway management. It includes UI components, state management, and functions to interact with external services and internal models.

classes.name: RemoteStatus
classes.description: An enum representing the current status of remote gateway probing, including idle, checking, success, and failure states.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the current status of the gateway environment and updates the view accordingly.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous test of the remote gateway connection and updates the remote status based on the result.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Attempts to locate and reveal the application log files in the Finder. Shows an alert if logs are not found.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway based on a discovered gateway and applies remote selection support.
